Carmen (AE): Quick one - Solara Engineering ready to sign POC orderform but procurement returned MSA+DPA with a CMK requirement for AWS KMS and asked for monthly commit billing. Need fast legal/sec/finance take. @Vikram @Zoe @Holly
Vikram (Legal): Drop their redline PDF. Short answer: we don't permit customer CMKs on Hosted multi-tenant. Offer Dedicated/Private or a Security Exception with strict controls. I'll prep a concise redline reply.
Zoe (Security): CMKs on Hosted = no. We can support CMKs only on Dedicated or Private with dedicated tenancy, key policy locking, audit-forwarding, and an emergency revoke runbook. No CMKs on Hosted.
Holly (Finance): Pricing note: at ~$15k/mo commit our usual cap is 5% and net30. Net60+10% needs RevOps approval. If they move to Dedicated we can consider net45+7%.
MartaOps: For DocuSign I need final PDFs and signer emails. Legal wants a provisional watermark until Security Exception done. Procurement asked not to add; we should follow Legal.
Carmen (AE): I'll present two options to procurement: (A) Hosted with Redwood-managed keys, standard terms; (B) Dedicated with CMKs, net45+7% and 48-72h provisioning. Will attach our redline and KMS addendum.
Vikram (Legal): I'll post redline reply and KMS addendum template by EOD. Tag envelope: "Legal - provisional acceptance pending Security Exception."
Zoe (Security): I'll post the minimal exception checklist. If they accept Dedicated, we'll provision within 48-72h once PO and finance cleared.
Holly (Finance): I can approve net45+7% pending Security sign-off. Otherwise escalate.
Carmen (AE): Thanks team, I'll update procurement and gather signer emails. :thumbsup:
